description: Calculate Singapore property loan affordability under MAS TDSR/MSR framework. Checks if a borrower can afford a property based on Total Debt Servicing Ratio (55%), Mortgage Servicing Ratio (30% for HDB), LTV limits, and stress-tested interest rates. Returns max affordable loan and property price. (PAID — auto-pay if wallet configured)

existing_monthly_debt.description: Total existing monthly debt obligations (car loans, credit cards, other mortgages)

housing_loan_count.description: Number of outstanding housing loans including this one

loan_tenure_years.description: Loan tenure in years (max 30 HDB, 35 private)

loan_type.description: hdb=HDB loan, bank_hdb=bank loan for HDB, bank_private=bank loan for private property

monthly_income.description: Gross monthly income in SGD (all borrowers combined)

name: sg_affordability
